providers.name: OpenRouter (free models)
providers.summary: Many open models for free with one key. Good for a first opinion on suspicious files; paid models catch more and explain better.
providers.limits: Free models allow about 20 requests a minute and 50 a day, or 1,000 a day once you have bought $10 of credits. Each analysed finding is one request.
providers.privacy: Some free models are run by providers that may keep or learn from what is sent. Only the suspicious code snippets are sent, never your keys or database contents.
steps: Create a free account at openrouter.ai.
Open Keys and press Create key. Name it after your site.
Copy the key (it starts with sk-or-), paste it into the API key box below and save.
Press Test connection. If a free model is busy, pick another one from the list.

providers.name: Groq (free plan)
providers.summary: Very fast answers, so a batch of findings is analysed in seconds. The free plan needs no card.
providers.limits: The free plan allows about 30 requests a minute and 1,000 a day for each model.
providers.privacy: Groq runs the models on its own servers. Only the suspicious code snippets are sent.
steps: Sign up at console.groq.com (a Google or GitHub account works).
Open API Keys and press Create API Key.
Copy the key (it starts with gsk_), paste it into the API key box below and save.
Press Test connection.

providers.name: Google Gemini (free tier)
providers.summary: Google's fast models with a generous context window. The free tier needs only a Google account.
providers.limits: The free tier has a daily limit for each model. Turn on billing in Google AI Studio to raise it.
providers.privacy: On the free tier Google may use what is sent to improve its products. With billing turned on, it does not.
steps: Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with a Google account.
Press Get API key, then Create API key.
Copy the key, paste it into the API key box below and save.
Press Test connection.

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.summary: The best code reader for malware analysis: careful verdicts, few false positives and clear cleanup advice. Pay as you go.
providers.limits: Pay as you go. Add credit under Billing before the key works. A full analysis of 20 findings costs cents on Opus 5.5.
providers.privacy: Anthropic does not train on API data by default. Only the suspicious code snippets and site facts are sent.
steps: Sign in at platform.claude.com.
Add credit under Billing.
Open API keys, press Create key and copy it (it starts with sk-ant-).
Paste it into the API key box below, save and press Test connection.

providers.name: OpenAI (GPT)
providers.summary: OpenAI's GPT models. Pay as you go.
providers.limits: Pay as you go. Add credit under Billing before the key works.
providers.privacy: OpenAI does not train on API data by default. Only the suspicious code snippets and site facts are sent.
steps: Sign in at platform.openai.com.
Add credit under Settings, Billing.
Open API keys, press Create new secret key and copy it (it starts with sk-).
Paste it into the API key box below, save and press Test connection.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.summary: Strong code reading at a very low price. Pay as you go.
providers.limits: Pay as you go: a small balance, such as $2, lasts a long time.
providers.privacy: DeepSeek processes requests on its own servers. Only the suspicious code snippets and site facts are sent.
steps: Create an account at platform.deepseek.com.
Add a balance under Top up. A few dollars is enough to start.
Open API Keys, press Create new API key and copy it (it starts with sk-).
Paste it into the API key box below, save and press Test connection.
